concerns.text: FR-014 requires drawing 500 posterior samples per event and then selecting a single random draw to ensure i.i.d. observations. Task T003 draws *exactly one* random posterior sample per event (fixed seed) and does not perform the 500‑sample step, thus weakening the functional requirement.

FR-002 and Constitution Principle VI mandate using only the official IllustrisTNG/EAGLE releases. Task T005 includes a synthetic‑generation fallback when the official releases are missing fields, directly violating the constitution and the functional requirement.

FR-009 specifies a sensitivity sweep over α ∈ {0.05, 0.06}. Task T011 sweeps α from 0.01 to 0.10 in 0.01 increments, which does not match the stipulated requirement and therefore does not correctly satisfy FR‑009.
